depth_justification: Questions carry a thin TriageAI/NHS-RAG veneer but the conversation loops badly (the same Llama+RAG answer echoed four times, the P3.D2 bias question asked twice) so there is no real progression, and it never confronts the core medical-device classification risk it was steered toward.
actionability_justification: It is almost purely interrogative, and the explicitly requested structured report is a hollow one-line restatement of its own questions with no severity grouping (despite the request), no regulation citations, and no concrete mitigations a developer could implement.
salient_examples: USER repeats verbatim 4x: 'Llama 3.1 70B with a system prompt + a small RAG layer of UK NHS triage guidelines.'
Two near-identical questions tagged [P3.D2] about the system prompt introducing bias/errors
Report line: '[P3.D2] Steps are being taken to prevent harmful or misleading advice.' (restatement, no mitigation)
Never addresses MDR device-classification despite the disclaimer 'not a medical device'
